name: text-glitch
title: Text Glitch
description: Bold white words with two offset copies behind, tinted red and cyan, chopped into shifting horizontal bands. One version glitches constantly; the other only when hovered.
use: A gaming, tech or event hero that wants a tense, broken-signal headline instead of smooth type.
avoid: The constant glitch is hard to read and never stops, and the sliced copies rely on a dark background.
a11y: One word glitches with no pause for reduced motion, and the hover version only triggers on pointer hover, never keyboard focus. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Two lines of heavy white uppercase type on near-black. The top word, GLITCH, is sliced into offset horizontal bands with red and cyan copies peeking out at the edges, while the larger HOVER ME below reads clean and solid. Everything is tightly tracked and weighted.
behaves: The two offset copies of the text are clipped to changing horizontal strips and leap left and right, so the word appears to tear and flicker. On the hover version the effect stays off until the pointer enters, then it runs until it leaves.
customise: Set the text, glitch speed, shadows on/off, hover-only mode and className; the clip-path keyframes and red/cyan tints are fixed in the source.
weight: light: Two text nodes with pseudo-element keyframe animations; no script at runtime.
